Group rides in Texas

116 recurring group rides around Texas: 72 road, 40 social, 13 mountain bike. 60 roll on weeknights, 50 on weekends. New to group rides? Start with Thursday Night Social Ride in Austin — it's no-drop, nobody gets left. Want to go fast? The Bagel Ride runs 18–20 mph on Violet Crown's page; the Strava club says 19–21 mph average over 50–60 miles.
